تستحلفون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْلِفُونَ (tastaḥlifūna) /tas.taħ.li.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# تُسْتَحْلَفُونَ (tustaḥlafūna) /tus.taħ.la.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
